subject: Acentry - transient debug log retention carveout & SIG evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@accentry.io>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: security@accentry.io, Tom Baker <tom.baker@accentry.io>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary debug log retention window + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Connor,

Quick background: during our pilot we've seen an intermittent deserialization failure that triggers a 72-hour debugging window on our side. Our security team is asking for clarity on Redwood's ability to preserve a tenant-scoped, write-once debug trace for up to 90 days in a restricted bucket (read-only, access logged) for forensic purposes.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood pause S3 lifecycle/TTL for a single tenant namespace for up to 90 days?
- If not, can you provide compensating controls (kept-in-memory KV snapshots, export hooks, proof-of-delete evidence) we can wave through our SIG review?
- We attached the SIG mapping spreadsheet we populated. Could you (1) confirm any fields you cannot answer and (2) point us to the CAIQ/SIG artifacts we can use to satisfy our procurement team?

We'd prefer a short call to align on controls — Tom and I are available Wednesday afternoon CET.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform Security
Accentry

---
Attachment: accentry_SIG_questions_v0.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 42KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@accentry.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary debug log retention window + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front:
- We can support tenant-scoped preservation for an exception up to 90 days, but it's an operational carveout (not an automatic policy) and requires a signed maintenance window and request ticket.
- Compensating controls we can offer immediately: write-once storage flag on preserved objects, KMS-logged key usage, and an auditable export bundle (signed manifest + SHA256).
- We'll attach a SIG/CAIQ extract that maps to your spreadsheet and call out any gaps.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a short proposal (policy + internal runbook) and the SIG evidence snapshot by EOD tomorrow.
2) If that looks good we can schedule a 30m sync Wed 14:00 CET.

Looping Jordan for the runbook/cutover steps and Priya for legal/procurement notes.

—Connor O'Brien
Principal, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: request-created-INC-48231 (ticket stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary debug log retention window + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Connor / team —

Draft of the operational carveout (internal):
- Scope: tenant namespace accentry-prod-543 (tenant tag + account id).
- Storage: preserved objects go to a read-only S3 prefix with lifecycle hold flag; bucket-level access is limited to a custodial IAM role (requires MFA).
- Retention duration: 90 days; autopurge triggered by signed release ticket or when TTL expires.
- Evidence: we produce a zipped export with manifest.json (signed by KMS), an access audit log slice, and a proof-of-delete certificate once purge completes.
- Change window: requires a maintenance agreement and 48h notice before activation.

Open questions for Priya: any legal redlines to the municipal data export? Also, can we offer a signed proof-of-delete that includes a retention ledger entry for the customer?

I'll prepare the PDF proposal with the runbook and typical artefact samples — attaching to Connor's outgoing packet.

-JB

---
Attachment: debug-log-retention-proposal-acc.pdf (PDF stub, 180KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary debug log retention window + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Connor / Jordan —

Legal/procurement notes:
- We can sign a limited SLA addendum but require a 90-day indemnity cap carveout clause (standard).
- For EU data: customer must specify whether the preserved objects contain EU personal data; if so, we'll enforce additional WORM (write-once-read-many) controls and KMS key material residency.
- Proof-of-delete: we can provide a signed certificate containing the object manifest and SHA256 digests; retention-ledger entries will be in our audit logs (we will provide a 30-day query export after deletion).

I'll draft a short addendum to the SOW to attach to the maintenance agreement. Please confirm who will own the release ticket on Accentry's side.

-Priya
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: SOW-addendum-draft.docx (doc stub, 12KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@accentry.io>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@accentry.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary debug log retention window + SIG/CAIQ evidence

Elena / Tom —

Thank you for the call today. Short summary and deliverables we agreed on:
1) Redwood will enact a tenant-scoped preservation hold for accentry-prod-543 for up to 90 days following a signed maintenance agreement and a service request (INC-48231).
2) During the hold we will: enable WORM on the preserve prefix, restrict access to the custodial role (MFA), record all key usage to KMS audit logs, and produce a signed export bundle (manifest + SHA256) on request.
3) After purge we will provide a signed proof-of-delete certificate and a 30-day post-delete audit slice.
4) Redwood legal (Priya) will run a two-paragraph SOW addendum and circulate for signature.
5) Action items: Redwood — share the SIG/CAIQ snapshot and the proposal PDF (attached). Accentry — confirm release-ticket owner and sign the maintenance agreement.

Attachments: accentry_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx; debug-log-retention-proposal-acc.pdf

Let me know if I've missed anything. If it looks good we'll move the SOW addendum to DocuSign by Friday.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Principal, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
